title: [review] handoff.rs:210: u64 to i64 cast produces negative integers for large values
description: sender_sequence, replay_index, and replay_bitfield are u64 but cast to i64 before CBOR encoding. Values >= 2^63 wrap to negative, producing semantically incorrect negative integers. While two's complement may cause correct round-trips, this is fragile and could break with CBOR libraries that treat large negatives differently.
